dbFeature.typescript: PostgreSQL with TypeORM, in Docker for development
dbFeature.javascript: PostgreSQL with Sequelize, in Docker for development

dbFolders.typescript:
database/              TypeORM connection, repository implementations, factory
      entities/            TypeORM entities (persistence model)
dbFolders.javascript:
database/              Sequelize connection, repository implementations, factory
      models/              Sequelize models (persistence model)

text.dbReadme:
PostgreSQL runs in Docker (`docker-compose.yml`, reachable only from this machine), with
the credentials of `.env`.

```bash
npm run docker:up      # start PostgreSQL (and Adminer on http://localhost:8080)
npm run db:seed        # sample data
npm run dev:docker     # database, sample data and dev server
npm run docker:down    # stop (docker:reset also deletes the data)
```
